subject: 藏地跨年代地域素材：单层织物商铺（原创扩展；具体城市年代适用待考）
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Convert THIS compact Tibetan guardhouse into a ONE-STOREY shop, preserving its projection and almost-square ground plan. Keep visible right wall BROAD like the reference. Target7m front by5m side, frontage only1.4 times depth, no elongated facade. REMOVE UPPER STOREY and lower flat roof vertically. Replace lower front doorway and windows with one open dark timber shop counter below a small plain cloth awning, few muted folded cloths and unlabelled jars. Keep white battered stone walls, exposed stone foot, dark window trim and restrained red band, flat low parapet, realistic matte stone/wood texture and detail density. Remove paving and vegetation outside wall footprint. BOTH ground directions must be 2:1 slopes+0.5/-0.5, parallel edges, no perspective, left-front horizontal span560 and front-right span400 in the same frame. Avoid the long rectangular shop trope: compact deep shop, enough depth visible. Upper-left light, short right contact shadow only. Whole sprite with generous TRANSPARENT margin, building fully opaque alpha255, outside alpha0, no halo. No people, text, symbols, pitched roof, scenery, watermark or modern objects.
negative: 无文字/现代物/人物/景观背景/厚地台；不拉伸、旋转、重绘或抠白底
created_time_basis: 工具PNG本地mtime，非服务端生成时间

geometry_qa.anchor_method: 人工可见墙脚L/F/R，后角按平行边推算；底面中心=(L+R)/2。非alpha底中点。

steps: alpha>1 determines bounding rectangle only; preserved all pixels inside rectangle
uniform LANCZOS resize with integer pixel rounding
paste without alpha mask onto transparent canvas; no repaint or warp

notes: 合入前审核返修：本轮2候选选第2；旧候选留档。原图及成品已view_image；仅裁切、等比缩放、透明扩边。占地未改，底角重新量取，实测残差见geometry_qa；不宣称全部几何通过，维持candidate。
